title: Quote line Qty/Unit$ filter to digits and clamp — negative/emoji/script never produce an invalid total
repro: Home → Create quote → New → Add line item
type -1, 999999999, and 👻 into Qty and Unit$
observed: Qty setter = max(1, digits-only); Unit$ setter = (digits-only ?? 0)*100. -1 → 1 / 0; emoji/script → 0. Total renders $0.00, Send stays disabled+faded (no client). No crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP1-quote-total.png)
expected: Numeric fields reject non-numeric input and never yield a negative total; Send gated on a client + line.

title: Capture Review merchant accepts a pasted <script> string and renders it verbatim as plain text (no injection sink)
repro: observe AI banner + field, then Save
observed: The string is stored verbatim and shown literally in the SwiftUI Text banner ('Looks like a <script>alert(1)</script> …'); SwiftUI Text never interprets markup, there is no WebView/HTML sink. Save (ungated) succeeds, reaches Saved. No crash, no execution. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP1-capture-merchant-5.png, EXP1-capture-saved.png)
expected: Free-text merchant is a plain String with no markup interpretation; not an XSS surface in a native SwiftUI view.

title: Capture Review merchant has no length cap — a 200-char name is accepted and saved
observed: The 200-char merchant is accepted into the free-text TextField (capture Save is ungated) and persists. No truncation/cap; the banner wraps it. No crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP1-capture-merchant-0.png)
expected: Acceptable for a free-text merchant field in v1; a length cap is a polish nicety, not a correctness bug. Downstream PDF/list layout already wraps/truncates on display.

title: Email-in review Save is gated on a positive numeric amount + non-empty date — junk amount can't resolve a failed receipt
repro: Profile → Email-in receipts → failed row → Review
observed: EmailInReviewView.canSave requires Double(amountText) > 0 AND non-empty date; the field is .decimalPad. Non-positive/non-numeric input leaves Save disabled. (Covered already by EmailInUITests as a hard contract.) No crash.
expected: Save stays disabled until a positive amount + date are present.

title: Rapid tab thrash (Snap↔Home↔Reports↔Activity↔Profile) for 25s does not freeze the tab bar or crash
repro: tap each tab as fast as possible in a 25s deadline loop, closing the capture overlay between hits
after the loop, return to Home
observed: After 25s of un-settled tab switching the shell stays interactive: Home renders and the profile switcher is present. No frozen tab, no crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP2-after-tab-thrash.png)
expected: Tab bar remains responsive under rapid switching; no stuck/frozen tab.

title: Single-slot router overlays (loyalty wallet) open/close back-to-back without orphaning
repro: confirm Home is reachable after each close
observed: Opening the wallet then closing it returns cleanly to Home (profile switcher present); the single router.overlay slot is fully released. No stacked/orphaned overlay. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP2-overlay-cycle.png)
expected: Each overlay fully replaces/releases the slot; no orphaned overlay.

title: Background + foreground mid-overlay survives — overlay/shell stays alive and dismissable
observed: After backgrounding mid-overlay and reactivating, the app returns to the foreground with the overlay/shell intact; the close affordance still works and the tab bar is responsive. No crash, no orphaned overlay. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP2-foreground-mid-overlay.png)
expected: App restores cleanly from background while an overlay is open.

title: Empty Reports renders its screen (no raw/blank, no crash) on a freshly-onboarded shell
repro: dev sign-in → onboard a single business profile, skip priming
observed: Reports renders its screen container with no transactions; no raw list, no blank white, no crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP3-empty-reports.png)
expected: Empty Reports shows its empty/zeroed state, not a blank or crash.

title: Empty Loyalty wallet renders its EmptyArt state
observed: The wallet opens with no cards and shows its empty state (LoyaltyWalletView uses EmptyArt). No crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP3-empty-loyalty.png)
expected: Empty wallet shows EmptyArt, not a blank list.

title: Empty Quotes list renders its EmptyArt state (business profile)
observed: The quotes list opens with no quotes and shows its empty state (QuoteListView uses EmptyArt). No crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP3-empty-quotes.png)
expected: Empty quotes list shows EmptyArt, not a blank list.

title: Empty Budgets list renders its EmptyArt state
observed: The budget list opens with no budgets and shows its empty state (BudgetListView uses EmptyArt). No crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP3-empty-budgets.png)
expected: Empty budgets list shows EmptyArt, not a blank list.

title: Empty Home renders its tracker empty-CTA, not a blank shell
repro: onboard a business profile, skip priming
observed: Home renders the budget-tracker empty CTA and quick actions on a profile with no data. No crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP3-empty-home.png)
expected: Empty Home shows its empty-state CTA, not a blank shell.

title: Profile switcher is NOT reachable while a single-slot overlay (loyalty wallet) is open — overlay correctly captures the screen
repro: attempt to tap the profile switcher while the overlay is open
observed: With the wallet overlay up, the profile switcher button is not hittable (the full-screen router overlay covers the Home header). No mid-overlay profile switch is possible, so no stale-data window exists. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP4-switcher-blocked-by-overlay.png, EXP4-wallet-p1.png)
expected: Single-slot overlays sit above the switcher so the active profile can't change underneath an open overlay.

title: After switching business→personal and reopening the wallet, p1 loyalty cards do NOT leak into p2
observed: On p2 the reopened wallet renders zero loyalty card rows (loyalty.card.row.* count == 0); the p1-seeded cards do not bleed across. No orphaned overlay, no crash. (artifacts/exploratory/EXP4-wallet-p2.png)
expected: Wallet rescopes to the active profile on switch; no other-profile rows leak (scope-by-active-profileId).
